productionFindings.trigger: A previously read stored chapter has nonempty original runtime variables; preUpdate refresh changes the book/chapter URL and the new URL compartment has no chapter variables.
productionFindings.cause: The merge carries old nonempty chapter variables by index even when URL changed. New preUpdate preview uses the new URL compartment. The already-committed App chapter therefore differs from the preview, and the subsequent strict transfer rejects STATE_CONFLICT.
productionFindings.impact: Refresh can report failure after publishing stale variables under a new URL. A subsequent original content request can observe variables belonging to the old chapter URL.
productionFindings.minimalRepair: In the existing merge, inherit old chapter variables only under the existing same-normalized-URL condition, alongside the existing cached-filename preservation. Keep UUID inheritance outside that condition.
productionFindings.regression: Extend the existing Native preUpdate method to actually fetch old paginated content first, prove nativeParsed and durable cache, refresh to new URLs, prove new variables are empty before transfer completes, then fetch new content and reopen the same owned book. No new method or selector.
